decisions.reason: A same-message MODIFY already records the accepted first-mint exception for both the random ticket and $5 referral commission.
A same-message MODIFY already adjusts leaderboard reward totals to exclude the first primary mint's ticket and commission.
A same-message MODIFY already records the first-mint accounting exception, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
The client accepted a one-off first-mint operational exception and did not require the persistent FAQ messaging to document that exhausted edge case.
The first-mint referral-reward exception does not change whether a successful primary purchase delivers the NFT ebook.
The accepted exception concerns first-mint referral rewards, not optional tip selection or tip transaction behavior.
The referral-commission exception does not alter payment-currency disclosure or selection behavior.
The accepted first-mint reward exception does not change the USDC approval-to-mint execution flow.
The decision does not change the condition that mint-success feedback appears only after an actual mint succeeds.
The first-mint referral-reward exception does not affect the deferred Transak provider, wallet provisioning, or fiat mint-delivery requirements.
The accepted reward exception does not alter ETH conversion, exact-output swap, refund, or shortfall behavior.
The source accepts a one-off historical exception and explicitly says it will not affect future behavior, so the general landing-page emphasis on the $5 referral commission remains valid unchanged.
